$comment: Shared behavioural contract for the research-description hygiene invariant (#2433). server/src/utils/researchHomeCardSummary.ts and client/src/utils/researchTextNormalization.ts carry independent copies of the same predicates, and researchHomeCardSummary.ts:192 documents that the two sides must stay in sync so served card text is byte-identical. Nothing enforced that. Both test suites read THIS file and drive their own public entry points, so the invariant is pinned by behaviour rather than by source text - a legitimate refactor of either copy still passes, and any behavioural drift fails on both sides. Add a case here rather than to only one suite.

$cardComment: Card-summary selection cases. These pin the pair the issue body does not name: researchHomeCardSummary.ts:192 declares itself a mirror of buildResearchHomeContextSummary in client/src/utils/researchDiscoveryAdapters.ts, and selectResearchDescriptionSummary plus its helpers and the sparse fallback strings are duplicated there too. Only the client short-circuits on a server-supplied cardDescription, which is by design (the server resolves it for list responses only), so these cases exercise the re-derivation path both sides share.

cardSummary.name: prefers a usable shortDescription when fullDescription is also usable

input.shortDescription: Studies how sleep consolidates spatial memory in rodents.
input.fullDescription: The laboratory investigates hippocampal replay during slow-wave sleep and its role in spatial memory consolidation.

cardSummary.expectText: Studies how sleep consolidates spatial memory in rodents.

cardSummary.name: falls back to fullDescription when shortDescription is suppressed

input.fullDescription: The laboratory investigates hippocampal replay during slow-wave sleep.
